args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (deployed to production) was failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback completed successfully; monitoring continues.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Situation:** checkout-api was on v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an 18% error rate.

**Action taken:**
1. **Investigated** — deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all regions — rollback completed successfully.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback; on-call was paged.

**Verification:** Post-rollback status confirms checkout-api is on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy**, with error rate down to 0.002.

Note: v2.3.1 remains the unhealthy release — the incident is open so the on-call engineer can investigate the root cause before any re-deploy attempt.
